match_winning_side_ck.name: match_winning_side_ck
match_winning_side_ck.value: winning_side is null or winning_side in (0, 1)

match_retired_side_ck.name: match_retired_side_ck
match_retired_side_ck.value: retired_side is null or retired_side in (0, 1)

match_winner_ck.name: match_winner_ck
match_winner_ck.value: (winning_side is not null) = (outcome is not null and outcome <> 'unplayed')

match_stopped_side_ck.name: match_stopped_side_ck
match_stopped_side_ck.value: (retired_side is not null) = coalesce(outcome in ('retired', 'walkover', 'conceded'), false)

match_score_ck.name: match_score_ck
match_score_ck.value: (score is not null) = coalesce(outcome in ('completed', 'retired'), false)

member_club_email_uq.name: member_club_email_uq
member_club_email_uq.where: "member"."deleted_at" is null and "member"."email" is not null

result_submission_side_index_ck.name: result_submission_side_index_ck
result_submission_side_index_ck.value: side_index is null or side_index in (0, 1)

result_submission_sideless_ck.name: result_submission_sideless_ck
result_submission_sideless_ck.value: side_index is not null or state <> 'pending'

result_submission_accepts_side_ck.name: result_submission_accepts_side_ck
result_submission_accepts_side_ck.value: accepts_submission_id is null or side_index is not null

result_submission_stopped_side_ck.name: result_submission_stopped_side_ck
result_submission_stopped_side_ck.value: (retired_side is not null) = coalesce(outcome in ('retired', 'walkover', 'conceded'), false)

result_submission_score_ck.name: result_submission_score_ck
result_submission_score_ck.value: (score is not null) = coalesce(outcome in ('completed', 'retired'), false)

season_dates_ck.name: season_dates_ck
season_dates_ck.value: starts_on is null or ends_on is null or ends_on >= starts_on
